narrative.title: The Spare-Parts Combination Audit
narrative.scenario: An aircraft depot tags every spare part with a weight, and the compliance team wants to know how many distinct bundles weigh exactly the certified payload k. Parts are physically distinct even when weights repeat, and a bundle is only a bundle if the total matches the certificate to the gram. The audit program counts every qualifying selection.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer n, an array arr of n non-negative integers, and a target sum.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the number of distinct subsets of arr whose elements sum to the target, modulo 10^9 + 7.

testCases.explanation: Either copy of the part alone is a valid distinct bundle.

hintLevels: Level 1: Swap the subset-sum OR for a running total — each cell counts ways instead of yes/no.
Level 2: ways[i][j] = ways[i-1][j] + ways[i-1][j-arr[i]] (second term only when arr[i] <= j).
Level 3: A zero-weight part doubles some entries: skipping it and taking it are both valid at equal sum.
